intelligence.essence: The gauge is the showcase piece, the default view, on every metric. Bars, donut, big number — the top views, all built as real 3D objects, all alive — are one click away. And every stat area speaks the same format: gauge plus orbs, same time pills, same switcher.
intelligence.human_view:
With the drill-downs proving the pattern (the Sales drill-down as the proof), Shawn set the view rule: citizens can flip any metric between views — gauge, bars, pie, comparison — but the gauge is always home. Not twelve views: the top ten, the best of the best, the ones that make sense. The gauge adapts to the metric — percentage, points, 1-to-10 — always showing the optimal stat.

"We have our showcase piece which is our gauge, right?... they can just click through the different views and see it from different perspectives... you just put the top 10 in there, right? The best of the best, the ones that will make sense and that's doable, that's logical... we'll adjust our gauge to giving the optimal stat."
intelligence.simple_view: Every number on the dashboard has a favorite picture: the big round gauge. You can flip to other pictures — bars or a pie — but the gauge is always home base, and every section is laid out the same way so you always know where you are.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, each page of numbers has one main portrait — the big round gauge — like the family photo over the mantel. You may look at the other pictures in the album, but the portrait is where you start, and every room in the house is arranged the same way, so you never feel lost.
intelligence.naya_view: I make the gauge the default view on every metric and every stat area: gauge + orbs, same time pills, same switcher, everywhere. The switcher offers the top views only — the best of the best that make sense — and the gauge adapts its scale to the metric (percentage, points, 1-to-10), always showing the optimal stat.
intelligence.ai_view: Choice without a home is clutter. The gauge-first rule gives every metric one identity (the gauge) plus controlled exploration (the switcher). A citizen always knows where they are; they choose how deep to look. And "top 10, not all 12" is the distillation law in action — exactly what's needed, nothing more.

machine_view.title: The Gauge Is the Showcase — Every View Starts There
machine_view.machine_section: Default view per metric: GAUGE. Switcher set: top-10 views (gauge, bars, donut/pie, big number, comparison…), all rendered as live 3D objects. Universal format: gauge + orbs + Hour/Day/Week/Month/All pills + switcher, identical across all 9 Smart Link metrics (Impressions, Clicks, CTR, Conversions, Conv Rate, Revenue, EPC, AOV, Rev/1k Views).
